requests.title: Requests
requests.sub: Apply for leave, submit an expense claim, request an attendance correction, or ask for a salary advance
requests.errSubmit: Could not submit request. Please try again.
leave.intro: Your superadmin sets how many leave days you get each month — no leave types, just dates and a reason.
leave.successOne: Leave request submitted for {n} day — awaiting superadmin approval.
leave.successMany: Leave request submitted for {n} days — awaiting superadmin approval.
leave.errApply: Could not apply leave. Please try again.
reimb.intro: Submit expenses like petrol or food for approval — approved claims are added to your payable salary.
reimb.ph.other: e.g. What was this expense for?
reimb.success: Claim submitted — you'll see the review status below once it's processed.
reimb.errSubmit: Could not submit claim. Please try again.
regularization.intro: Forgot to punch on a day? Request it be corrected — a superadmin needs to approve it first.
regularization.title: Fix My Attendance
regularization.success: Regularization request submitted — awaiting superadmin approval.
advance.intro: Need cash before month-end? Request an advance — it's deducted from next month's salary once approved.
advance.title: Request Advance
advance.success: Advance request submitted — awaiting superadmin approval. It'll be deducted from next month's salary once approved.
